paragraphs: Pavlos Protopapas is Scientific Program Director at Harvard’s Institute for Applied Computational Science (SEAS), where he has taught data science and AI since 2009. He designed and teaches CS1090A/B, Harvard’s core data science sequence (about 450 and 300 students), and created AC215, Productionizing Large Language Models. His HarvardX courses have reached more than 600,000 learners.

His research spans physics-informed neural networks and scientific ML, foundation models for astronomical time series (ASTROMER), and LLMs for science at NASA’s Astrophysics Data System. He is co-author of Solving Differential Equations and Inverse Problems with AI (World Scientific, 2026).
source: Biography supplied by Pavlos Protopapas on November 14, 2026.
